# Bahnsen

*1830 – 1881 · German*

German philosopher, a dissident pupil of [Schopenhauer](../philosophers/schopenhauer.md): his tragic dialectic sees the will torn within itself by contradictions that nothing resolves, neither reason nor history. He also founded a characterology.
